title: Kenya Confirms Second Ebola Case, a Quarantined Relative of the First
detail: WHO is supporting Kenya after a 39-year-old man, a relative of the first patient, tested positive for Bundibugyo virus. He was already in quarantine as a contact and developed symptoms on 13 October. The first case arrived in Nairobi via Uganda on 3 October and died two days later. More than 40 contacts have been identified; WHO says no community spread has been detected and does not recommend travel restrictions.
